notes: E1 (block-registry.constants.ts) and E2 (block-rules.constants.ts) define what is required and when. E15 (content-block.service.ts) + E31/E35 (its import of the registry and model references) are the enforcement layer. E19 (listing.validation.ts) is where readiness checks use the block registry before status transitions. E48/E49 (Issues #29/#30) and E77/E78 (PRs #31/#32) document the design intent. Critical distractors: E5 (contracts/commands/registry.ts) and E6 (contracts/events/registry.ts) are strong keyword matches on 'registry' but are the PubSub command/event registries, not block registries — highest risk of confusion. E96 (history: contracts/commands/registry.ts touched 3x) amplifies this distractor. E7 (smart-contract.model.ts) and E16 (blockchain migration) match 'block' but are blockchain infrastructure.
